n-k-k2-01.title: Chirevo nezvekirasi yose
n-k-k2-01.goal: Shandisa kuzvitaridza sehumbowo kusarudza kuti mutsara nezvevose uri chokwadi here, ona kuti kusiyana kwakawanda sei kunouparadza, uye unyore mutsara unokodzera humbowo.
n-k-k2-01.material:
'Kirasi yako ine boka rehurukuro. Kirasi ine vadzidzi vana. Mumwe nemumwe akanyora kuzvitaridza kupfupi nezvekudya. Wobva wanyora 수진 mutsara nezvekirasi.

민호: 저는 김치를 좋아해요. 매일 먹어요.
에밀리: 저는 김치를 안 좋아해요. 불고기를 좋아해요.
지아: 저는 김치를 좋아해요. 그런데 매운 김치는 못 먹어요.
토마스: 저는 김치를 좋아해요. 지난주에 처음 먹었어요.

수진: 우리 반 네 명은 모두 김치를 좋아해요.

(모두 = all.)'
n-k-k2-01.s.s1.prompt: 수진 anoti vose vana vemakirasi vanoda kimchi. Mutsara womudzidzi upi unoratidza kuti chirevo chake hachisi chokwadi?
n-k-k2-01.s.s1.hint.0: Mudzidzi mumwe nemumwe, sarudza kuti mutsara unokuudza kuti anoda kimchi here.
n-k-k2-01.s.s1.hint.1: Chengeta mitsara inopindura 'Munhu uyu anoda kimchi here?' zvakananga chete, uye uienzanise nemutsara wa수진.
n-k-k2-01.s.s1.r.a: Kuidya zuva rega rega kunotsigira chirevo; hakugoni kuratidza kuti mumwe haadi kimchi.
n-k-k2-01.s.s1.r.b: Tarisa kuzvitaridza kwose: 지아 anotiwo anoda kimchi. Haagoni kudya rudzi runorwadza, izvo zvisiri kusada kimchi.
n-k-k2-01.s.s1.r.d: Kuidya kekutanga vhiki rapera hakuudzi chinhu nezvekuti anoida here.
n-k-k2-01.s.s1.explain: 에밀리 chete ndiye anopindura 'Do you like kimchi?' neaiwa. Chirevo chine vese chinoputswa nemunhu mumwe asingabvumirani. Mimwe mitsara inotaura nezve kuti zvakadini, kupisa kwazvo kana rinhi, kwete nezvekufarira.
n-k-k2-01.s.s2.prompt: Mutsara wa수진 une 모두 (vose). Vadzidzi vangani vana vaifanira kusabvumirana kuti mutsara wake ushaye chokwadi?
n-k-k2-01.s.s2.hint.0: Fungidzira kirasi ine vadzidzi 100. Waifanira kuwana vanhu vangani vasingadi kimchi?
n-k-k2-01.s.s2.hint.1: 'Vose vanofarira' chokwadi kana pasina akasiiwa chete. Verenga kuti kunze kumwe kwakadini kunoiputsa.
n-k-k2-01.s.s2.r.a: Vaviri vanopfuura zvinodiwa. 'Vose' inopikira nezvemunhu mumwe nemumwe.
n-k-k2-01.s.s2.r.c: Vatatu vanopfuura zvinodiwa. 'Vose' inopikira nezvemunhu mumwe nemumwe.
n-k-k2-01.s.s2.r.d: Vana vanopfuura zvakanyanya zvinodiwa. 'Vose vanofarira' inopinzwa ruzha kana munhu mumwe chete asingadi.
n-k-k2-01.s.s2.explain: 'Vose' inopikira nezvemunhu mumwe nemumwe, saka kunze kumwe chete kunokwana kuiputsa. Mutsara senge '대부분' (vazhinji) unogona kupfuura nekunze kushoma.
n-k-k2-01.s.s3.prompt: Nyora mutsara MUMWE wechiKorea une rukudzo nezve kimchi nevadzidzi vana unova wechokwadi kumataurirwo ana.
n-k-k2-01.s.s3.hint.0: Sarudza kutanga kuti vangani pavana vanofarira kimchi, wobva wanyora mutsara wechokwadi kuboka iroro chaiyo.
n-k-k2-01.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa mutsara wako neruzivo rwa에밀리 usati wapedza.
n-k-k2-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Mutsara wangu wechokwadi kumataurirwo ese mana, kusanganisira ewa에밀리 here?
n-k-k2-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ndakadzivisa 'vose' kunze kwekunge ndataura kunze here?

n-k-k2-02.title: Chinyorwa chinoenderana nechati here?
n-k-k2-02.goal: Enzanisa chipfupiso chakanyorwa nechati yepakutanga, tsvaga mitsara yakashandura dimikira, taura kuti rudzii rwedimikira rwakachinja, uye unyore chipfupiso chakagadziriswa.
n-k-k2-02.material:
민수 ne 지나 vanoronga Satidha pachati. Wobva 지나 anyora nyaya kuna amai vake.

민수: 지나 씨, 토요일 오후 두 시에 학교 앞에서 만나요.
민수: 영화는 세 시 반에 시작해요. 영화를 보고 저녁을 먹어요.
민수: 저녁을 먹고 아홉 시에 집에 가요.
지나: 네, 좋아요!

(앞 = pamberi pe. 집에 가요 = enda kumba.)
n-k-k2-02.prereq.0: Unoziva mazwi enguva echiKorea (두 시, 아홉 시)
n-k-k2-02.s.s1.prompt: 지나 anonyora nyaya kuna amai vake. Mimwe mitsara haienderani nechati. Sarudza mutsara mumwe wenyaya usingaenderani nechati.
n-k-k2-02.s.s1.hint.0: Pfuura nyaya mutsara nemutsara uye uwane dimikira rimwe chete muchati: ndiani, zuva ripi, kupi, nguva ipi.
n-k-k2-02.s.s1.hint.1: Pamutsara mumwe nemumwe, taura kuti chati inopa nzvimbo kana nguva here, uye uenzanise mazwi rimwe nerimwe.
n-k-k2-02.s.s1.explain: Mitsara miviri haienderani nechati. Mutsara 2 unoti vanosangana pamberi pecinema, asi 민수 akanyora 학교 앞 (pamberi pechikoro). Mutsara 5 unoti 여덟 시 (8 o'clock), asi 민수 akanyora 아홉 시 (9 o'clock). Mitsara 1, 3 ne 4 inoenderana.
n-k-k2-02.s.s2.prompt: Mitsara isina kururama yenyaya inosiyana nechati nenzira mbiri dzakasiyana. Peya ipi?
n-k-k2-02.s.s2.hint.0: Pidigura madimikira ehurongwa kuita mapoka: ndiani, zuva ripi, kupi, nguva ipi.
n-k-k2-02.s.s2.hint.1: Mapoka maviri api ane madimikira akachinja pakati pechati nenyaya?
n-k-k2-02.s.s2.o.a: Zuva risina kururama nenzvimbo isina kururama
n-k-k2-02.s.s2.o.b: Munhu asina kururama nezuva risina kururama
n-k-k2-02.s.s2.o.c: Nzvimbo isina kururama nenguva isina kururama
n-k-k2-02.s.s2.o.d: Nguva isina kururama nemunhu asina kururama
n-k-k2-02.s.s2.explain: Nyaya inochinja kwavanosangana (영화관 panzvimbo ye 학교) nenguva yavanoenda kumba (여덟 시 panzvimbo ye 아홉 시). Ndiani nezuva ripi zvakarurama.
n-k-k2-02.s.s3.prompt: Nyora zvakare nyaya kuna amai muchiKorea chine rukudzo chakarurama (mitsara 2 kana 3 mipfupi). Shandisa chati kupa nzvimbo yekusangana, nguva yekusangana nenguva yaanoenda kumba.
n-k-k2-02.s.s3.hint.0: Rondedzera kutanga madimikira matatu: kwavanosangana, nguva yavanosangana, nguva yaanoenda kumba.
n-k-k2-02.s.s3.hint.1: Tevedzera dimikira rimwe nerimwe kubva mumameseji ana민수 uye uchengete nguva imwe neimwe nehurongwa hwayo, wobva wawedzera mapendero ane rukudzo (-요).
n-k-k2-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Nzvimbo nenguva dzese munyaya yangu dzinoenderana nechati here?
n-k-k2-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Amai vangu vaizoziva kupi nerinhi kundiona here?

n-k-k2-03.title: Kukoka kune mikaha
n-k-k2-03.goal: Sarudza kuti ndezvokwadi zvipi zvisipo mukukoka kupfupi, cherekedza kuti mhinduro isina kujeka haikwani, uye ukumbire zvaunoda.
n-k-k2-03.material:
Svondo rapfuura wakasangana ne지호 mukirasi yemutauri. Nhasi akutumira meseji. Hauna kumboenda kumba kwake.

지호: 토요일에 우리 집에서 파티를 해요. 꼭 오세요!

(꼭 = ndapota unyatsouya.)
n-k-k2-03.prereq.0: Unoziva mazwi ekubvunza akapfava (몇 시, 어디)
n-k-k2-03.prereq.2: Unogona kuti 'ndichaenda' ne 'ndatenda' muchiKorea chakapfava chine rukudzo (갈게요, 고마워요), zvakanyorwa mumazano
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.prompt: Unoda kuenda. Mibvunzo ipi yaunofanira kubvunza usati wasvika kuparty chaizvo? Sarudza yese yaunoida chaizvo.
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.hint.0: Fungidzira kuti ndiSatidha mangwanani uye unoda kuenda. Chii chaizokuvharira kubuda?
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.hint.1: Pidigura mibvunzo: ipi inobatsira kusvika, ipi yekuziva chete?
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.r.b: Kuti vaeni vangani vanouya hakuchinji kuti unogona kuwana nzvimbo kana kusvika panguva.
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.r.d: Inobatsira uye ine rukudzo kubvunza, asi unogona kusvika usingazvizivi. Hazvidikanwi kusvika.
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.r.e: Kuziva mhemberero kunogona kukubatsira kusarudza chipo, asi hakukuudzi rinhi kana kupi kuenda.
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.explain: Meseji inopa zuva (토요일) asi haipi nguva, uye 우리 집 haikuudzi kero yemunhu waunga usati wamboenda kwaari. Nguva nenzvimbo ndizvo zvokwadi zviviri zvaunoda kusvika.
n-k-k2-03.s.s1.acc.0: Kubvunza zvekuuya nazvo kune hanya uye kwakanaka. Hazvidikanwi kusvika panzvimbo nenguva dzakarurama chete.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.prompt: 지호 anopindura mibvunzo yako nemutsara mumwe chete: '저녁에 오세요.' Zvino unoziva zvakakwana nezvenguva here?
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.hint.0: Fungira kuti izwi 저녁 rinogona kuvhara maawa mangani.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.hint.1: Zvibvunze: vaeni vaviri vangaverenga mutsara uyu vokasvika maawa matatu akasiyana here?
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.o.a: Hongu. 저녁 inguva, saka ndinogona kuuya panguva ipi neipi manheru.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.r.a: 저녁 (manheru) inovhara maawa akati wandei. Kana ukasvika uchinonoka, unogona kuramba kutanga; kana ukasvika nekukurumidza, hapana angave akagadzirira.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.o.b: Kwete zvino. 저녁 inovhara maawa akati wandei, saka ndichiri kuda awa chaiyo.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.o.c: Hongu. Ndinoziva zuva nechikamu chezuva, saka ndinogona kurongera kusvika kwangu.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.r.c: Zuva nechikamu chezuva hazvisati zviri nguva chaiyo yekusvika.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.o.d: Kwete zvino. 저녁 zvinoreva 'kudya kwemanheru', saka ndinofanira kubvunza kuti kudya kunopiwa here.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.r.d: 저녁 inogona kureva 'manheru' kana 'kudya kwemanheru'. Pano inizwi renguva nokuda kwe 에 ne 오세요, uye chikafu hachingakuudza kuti usvike rinhi.
n-k-k2-03.s.s2.explain: 저녁 inongotaura chikamu chezuva. Kuti usvike panguva chaiyo uchiri kuda awa, semuenzaniso 여섯 시.
n-k-k2-03.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga nekumutenda kana kutaura kuti uchauya (고마워요 = ndatenda, 갈게요 = ndichaenda).
n-k-k2-03.s.s3.hint.1: Ndezvokwadi zvipi kubva murondedzero yako yemibvunzo yekutanga zvinodiwa nemunhu asati abva kumba? Zvikumbire nependero rine rukudzo (-요).
n-k-k2-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Mhinduro yangu ine rukudzo rwakakwana kumunhu wandakasangana naye svondo rapfuura chete here?

n-k-k2-04.title: Basiketi ine mitemo
n-k-k2-04.goal: Verenga mamiriro akati wandei mumutauro mupfupi wekutenga, wobva waita mabhasiketi anopfuura mumwe anosangana nemamiriro ese, uye uzivise rimwe rebhasiketi muchiKorea.
n-k-k2-04.material:
민지: 오늘 시장에서 과일을 사요. 사과는 한 개에 천 원, 귤은 한 개에 오백 원이에요.
민지: 사과도 사고 귤도 사요. 그런데 사과가 귤보다 적어요.
민지: 과일은 모두 일곱 개 이상 사요. 오천 원을 넘으면 안 돼요.

(이상 = nhamba iyi kana kupfuura. 넘으면 안 돼요 = haafanire kupfuura. -보다 = kupfuura.)
n-k-k2-04.thinking.2: Kuona kuti miganhu inobvumira mhinduro dzakawanda
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.prompt: Mumeseji yechipiri ya민지, '사과가 귤보다 적어요' inokuudza chii nezvebhasiketi?
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.hint.0: Tsvaga kuti muchero upi ndiyo nyaya (inoratidzwa ne 가) uye upi ndiwo unoenzaniswa nawo (unoratidzwa ne 보다).
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.hint.1: Verenga 적어요 se 'huwandu hushoma' uye usarudze kuti muchero upi une huwandu hushoma.
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.r.a: 적어요 zvinoreva 'mashoma / zvishoma'. -보다 inoratidza chinoenzaniswa nacho, saka maapuro ndiwo nhamba shoma.
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.r.b: Mutsara unoenzanisa huwandu hwakaviri uye unoti humwe hushoma; hauti vakaenzana.
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.r.d: Mutsara wapfuura unoti 사과도 사고, saka maapuro ari mubhasiketi; 적어요 inoti 'mashoma', kwete 'hapana'.
n-k-k2-04.s.s1.explain: A (사과가) B (귤보다) 적어요 = A mashoma kupfuura B. Saka huwandu hwemaapuro hushoma kupfuura huwandu hwematangerine.
n-k-k2-04.s.s2.prompt: Mumwe anokurudzira maapuro 3 nematangerine 5. Mamiriro api e민지 anoputswa nebhasiketi iri?
n-k-k2-04.s.s2.hint.0: Tarisa mamiriro rimwe panguva nenhamba 3 ne 5.
n-k-k2-04.s.s2.hint.1: Kumamiriro emari, verenga mutengo wemaapuro wega newematangerine wega, wobva wawedzera.
n-k-k2-04.s.s2.r.b: Maapuro 3 mashoma kupfuura matangerine 5, saka mamiriro aya akarurama.
n-k-k2-04.s.s2.r.c: 3 + 5 = 8 michero, ari 7 kana kupfuura, saka izvi zvakarurama.
n-k-k2-04.s.s2.r.d: Bhasiketi rine maapuro nematangerine zvose, saka izvi zvakarurama.
n-k-k2-04.s.s2.explain: Maapuro 3 anodhura 3,000 won uye matangerine 5 anodhura 2,500 won, pamwe chete 5,500 won. Izvo zvinopfuura 5,000. Mamiriro matatu akasara anosangana.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.prompt: Tsvaga mabhasiketi 3 akasiyana anosangana neMAMIRIRO ESE ari mumameseji e민지. a = huwandu hwemaapuro (사과), t = huwandu hwematangerine (귤).
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.hint.0: Isa mamiriro mumazwi ako kutanga: maapuro mashoma kupfuura matangerine, michero 7 kana kupfuura, 5,000 won kana mashoma.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.hint.1: Edza apuro 1 uye utsvage huwandu hwematangerine hunoita michero 7 kana kupfuura; wobva watarisa mutengo.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.hint.2: Tarisa mari yekupedzisira: 1,000 x maapuro + 500 x matangerine, wobva wachinja huwandu hwemaapuro.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.fail.c0: Tenga michero yakazara chete (nhamba yakazara ye 개).
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.fail.c1: 사과도 사고 귤도 사요: kanokwana chimwe chimwe.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.fail.c2: 사과가 귤보다 적어요: maapuro anofanira kuva mashoma kupfuura matangerine.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.fail.c3: 일곱 개 이상: michero 7 kana kupfuura pamwe chete.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.fail.c4: Huwandu hwose hunopfuura 5,000 won (apuro 1,000 rimwe nerimwe, tangerine 500 rimwe nerimwe).
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.explain: Semuenzaniso apuro 1 + matangerine 7 = 4,500 won; 2 + 5 = 4,500 won; 3 + 4 = 5,000 won. Mabhasiketi mazhinji anokodzera nokuti mameseji anopa miganhu, kwete odha imwe chaiyo.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.because.prompt: Sarudza bhasiketi RIMWE rako uye uudze 민지 mumeseji pfupi ine rukudzo kuti uchatenga maapuro nematangerine mangani uye mutengo wose.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.because.hint.0: Tora bhasiketi rimwe kubva murondedzero iri pamusoro uye unyore nhamba dzaro mbiri.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.because.hint.1: Taura maapuro, wobva wataura matangerine, wobva wataura huwandu hwose mu won.
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.because.selfAssess.0: Nhamba dziri mumeseji yangu dzinoenderana nebhasiketi rimwe randakagadzira here?
n-k-k2-04.s.s3.because.selfAssess.1: Huwandu hwose hwakarurama here (1,000 x maapuro + 500 x matangerine)?

n-k-k2-05.title: Ndiani akazviita? Mutsara haurevi
n-k-k2-05.goal: Teedzera nhaurirano pfupi isina nyaya, cherekedza kuti kuverenga kwako kwekuti ndiani akaita chii kunochinja sei, uye unyore patsva mutsara kuti pasave nemunhu anogona kuupindudza.
n-k-k2-05.material: 하나 anotaura neshamwari yake 준호 nezveSvondo rapfuura. MuchiKorea nyaya inowanzosiiwa kana ichiita seyakajeka. Verenga zvishoma nezvishoma: nyaya ine zvikamu zvitatu.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.prompt: Verenga chikamu chimwe nechimwe, sarudza kuverenga kunoratidzika kuri kwakanyanya, wobva waenderera mberi. Mhinduro yako inogona kuchinja kana uchiverenga zvakawanda.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.hint.0: Sarudza uchishandisa zvawaverenga kusvika zvino bedzi.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kuti mazwi api anotaura munhu uye zviito zvipi zvisina munhu wakabatanidzwa nazvo.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Mutsara wechipiri hauna musoro wemutsara. MuKorea kazhinji musoro wemutsara unosiiwa kana wakajeka kubva mumamiriro ezvinhu, asi pano hama (동생이) ndiye munhu wekupedzisira kutaurwa uye 하나 ndiye anotaura, saka panguva ino haugone kuva nechokwadi.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Mutsara unoti 만들었어요, saka mumwe munhu akazviita, asi vanhu bedzi munyaya i 하나 nehama yake diki.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.1.after: 하나 pamwe akazvigadzira iye amene, asi akapindura mubvunzo wezvehunyanzvi hwehama yake, saka kuchiri kuverenga kunoratidzika bedzi.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: 하나 anoti hama yake haigoni kubika, saka izvi hazvingabvi, asi haasati ataura kuti ndiani akabika.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Chikamu chekutanga chinoti 만들었어요 (yakagadzirwa), saka mumwe munhu akaibika.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Mhinduro yake i yehunyanzvi hwehama, haitauri kuti akagovana kubika.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.2.after: 먹었어요 zvakare haina musoro wemutsara. Zvinonyanya kuva 하나, pamwe nehama yake. Kana munhu akaratidzwa pachena (동생이 했어요), chiratidzo chinokuudza kuti ndiani; kana pasina chakaratidzwa, unofanira kushandisa mamiriro ezvinhu uye dzimwe nguva kubvunza.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: 하나 ndiye akati 제가 만들었어요; hapana chinoratidza hama bedzi seakadya. 설거지는 동생이 ine chiratidzo, asi 먹었어요 haina.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.st.2.r.d: 맛있게 먹었어요 inoti yakadyiwa uye yakafadzwa.
n-k-k2-05.s.s1.reflect: MuKorea musoro wemutsara unowanzosiiwa kana mamiriro ezvinhu achiupa, asi munhu wekupedzisira waunoverenga nezvake haasi nguva dzose anoita chiito chinotevera. Tsvaga zviratidzo (이/가, 은/는, 제가) uye uchengete kuverenga kuri kuvhurika kana pasina chakaratidzwa. Kana zvakakosha, bvunza.
n-k-k2-05.s.s2.prompt: Nyora patsva mitsara miviri yekutanga ya 하나 muKorea inoremekedza kuti pasave nemunhu anganzwisisa zvisirizvo kuti ndiani akagadzira bibimbap: i 하나 amene, sezvawakadzidza muchat. Chekutanga: 어제 동생이 우리 집에 왔어요. 비빔밥을 만들었어요.
n-k-k2-05.s.s2.hint.0: Enzanisa mutsara wako nechekutanga: ruzivo rupi rusipo mumutsara wechipiri?
n-k-k2-05.s.s2.hint.1: Chikamu chiri mushure mezwi remunhu (-가 / -이) chinoratidza kuti munhu uyu ndiye akaita chiitiko.
n-k-k2-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Muverengi anogona kuziva kuti ndiani akagadzira bibimbap asingatarise chat here?
